description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Spares Management product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Internal Operations).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Spares Management.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle Spares Management, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Spares Management. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H).
